components.name: 云端跳一跳
components.loop: ready -> hold to charge -> release -> bounded ballistic flight -> land/score or fall/result -> restart
components.inputs: SW1 start/restart and charge/release; SW2 pause; touch charge area; global exit retains precedence
components.entities: original pet sprite, current/target platforms, shadow, charge feedback
components.visual: clean airy pastel diorama, no visible grid; HUD and touch targets remain live
components.capabilityGap: generic continuous scene, hold/release/cancel, landing and procedural bounded placement require coordinated runtime extension

components.name: 每日黄历
components.loop: open at today in Asia/Shanghai -> browse date -> traditional-detail pages -> return to today
components.inputs: SW1 today; SW2 details/back; joystick left/right date or detail page; matching touch controls
components.data: versioned offline date records owned by PC resource package; lunar/solar terms checked against HKO; folk宜忌 clearly not predictions or advice; festivals not statutory holidays
components.visual: ivory paper, vermilion accents, small pet vignette; real text and generous button padding
components.runtime: existing app surface plus new bounded calendar host interpreter; no package scripts, no firmware-specific calendar branch

components.name: 快速读懂一本书
components.loop: real device entry draws a book without immediate repeat -> lossless full paging/narration -> category or another book -> exit cancels audio
components.inputs: SW1 random book/confirm category; SW2 category/cancel; joystick and swipe page/category; no favorites
components.data: 100 economic, business and cognition books; original detailed critical guides, not unlicensed copied text or invented quotations; bibliographic provenance
components.visual: warm cream and sage reading room with pet, legible live text, restrained two-button layout
components.runtime: bounded library reader and pet voice/global-volume narration; need original-guide attribution and device-entry randomization
